description: Use this when asking 'How much would it cost to replace my driveway?' or 'Compare concrete, asphalt and pavers for a 20 by 30 foot driveway.'. Returns national installed ranges with no published typical figure. One call compares all ten surfaces. Base, drainage and permits are not priced; removal is priced only for an existing concrete driveway. Includes unpriced checks, two separate national reference cards and dated sources. Pure arithmetic, no network or model. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

existing.description: Existing driveway surface. Removal is priced only for existing concrete.

sections.description: 1–10 sections, each 1–10,000 sq ft; total 20–10,000 sq ft. Use length_ft + width_ft OR area_sqft per section.

area_sqft.description: Area in square feet instead of both dimensions.

length_ft.description: Positive length in feet; use with width_ft OR area_sqft.

name.description: Optional section name, at most 40 characters.

width_ft.description: Positive width in feet; use with length_ft OR area_sqft.

surface.description: Chosen installed surface; one call compares all ten surfaces.

name: driveway_cost
title: Driveway Cost Calculator
